**PotentialNoise 2.5.1**

- **Loads about 100 times faster.** It used to measure its own noise every time it loaded (6 seconds of noise for each of its 12 signals), which took about 140 ms on an MPC One. The levels are now built in, the same calibrated numbers, so it loads in well under a millisecond like the rest of the suite. Levels and sound are unchanged.
